old_caption: The video captures a vibrant urban street scene on a sunny day. The camera focuses on a yellow bus parked along the side of a narrow cobblestone street lined with historic buildings. The bus is marked with "MOBILIDADE FLEXIVEL" (Flexible Mobility) and features a detailed illustration of a bridge and cityscape on its rear. The bus has a modern design with visible air vents and a license plate reading "2965 MAN." The surrounding architecture includes stone facades with large windows, some adorned with balconies featuring intricate ironwork. A few pedestrians can be seen walking along the sidewalk, adding life to the scene. The sky above is clear and blue, indicating pleasant weather. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, providing a steady view of the bus and its surroundings, emphasizing the urban environment and the architectural details of the buildings.

caption: The video captures a close, low-angle view of the rear and right side of a yellow double-decker city bus, badged MAN with fleet number 2965. On the tinted rear window, the slogan MOBILIDADE FLEXÍVEL sits above a white line-drawing of a suspension bridge, beside a column of three blue accessibility icons. A round red tail light and a small red side marker stay lit throughout. Weathered pale facades line the left, while an iron-balconied building, a church tower and a crane fill the right under clear blue sky. The bus drifts gradually rightward within the frame, its MAN logo, icon column and tail-light cluster translating together while size, shape and orientation stay constant. The nearer left building shifts slightly the opposite way and the far background stays fixed. The bridge drawing, text and icons remain legible and unchanged, merely carried along by this slow drift, already underway at the first frame and continuing at the last.

review_issues.quote: Above the rear window sits the slogan MOBILIDADE FLEXÍVEL over a white line-drawing of a suspension bridge
review_issues.problem: The slogan oval and the bridge line-drawing are decals printed on the tinted rear-window glass itself (building reflections are visible within the same dark panel), not positioned above the window. The slogan sits on the upper part of the window, over the drawing.

review_issues.quote: a parallax in which the closest object travels most
review_issues.problem: The bus content translates rightward while the nearer left building translates leftward, i.e. the two nearest objects move in opposite directions. A single viewpoint parallax would carry them the same way, so labeling the bus's drift as parallax is unsupported; only the relative shifts are observable.
